definition: Binge-eating disorder is an eating disorder marked by repeated episodes of overeating in which a person eats unusually large amounts, often quickly or when not physically hungry, and later feels distress such as shame, guilt, or disgust. Unlike bulimia nervosa, these episodes are not regularly followed by compensatory behaviors such as purging or excessive exercise, and they are not limited to episodes occurring only with anorexia nervosa or bulimia nervosa.
